SHIN_GETTER_TRANSFORM.title: Transform

SHIN_GETTER_FORM_CARD.title: Form-Specific Card
SHIN_GETTER_FORM_CARD.description: A card with an effect specific to the current form.

SHIN_GETTER_STACK.title: Stack
